entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Omprakash S/o Shri Ghevarram, B/c Vishnoi, Aged 35 years,
R/o Sanghasani, PS Luni, District Jodhpur.

----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Chiranjilal Mali For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Bishnoi, PP  Mr. JS Choudhary, Sr. Adv. assisted by  Mr. Pradeep Choudhary  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 17/08/2023

Instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner against the order dated 20.04.2019, passed by learned Additional Session Judge (Women Atrocities Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan whereby the learned Judge rejected the petitioner's application filed under Section 233 Cr.P.C. for calling the S.I. Nitin Dave for defence evidence.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge (Women Atrocities Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the witness SI Nitin Dave was the Investigating Officer in FIR No.267/2011 registered at PS Mahila Thana, Jodhpur for offence under Sections 498A, 406,
306, 341 IPC, who after investigation filed charge-sheet No.295/2011 before the competent court.

Counsel submits that the Investigating Officer of the present case has filed the statements of the witnesses recorded in FIR No.267/2011 by SI [2023:RJ-JD:25932] (2 of 3) [CRLMP-3244/2019]
Nitin Dave along with the charge-sheet of the present case.
Therefore, in order to prove his innocence, the evidence of SI Nitin Dave is very much important.
But, the learned trial court without assigning any reason, rejected the petitioner's application.
Therefore, it is prayed that the impugned order may be quashed and the SI Nitin Dave may be called for his defence evidence.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the respondent No.2 have opposed the prayed made by counsel for the petitioner and submitted that the learned trial court has rightly rejected the petitioner's application under Section 233 of Cr.P.C. and thus requires no interference from this Court.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the order impugned.

Since the witness SI Nitin Dave was the Investigating Officer in FIR No.267/2011 registered at PS Mahila Thana, Jodhpur for offence under Sections 498A, 406, 307 IPC, who after investigation filed charge-sheet No.295/2011 before the competent court and he recorded the statements of the witnesses, therefore, in order to prove his innocence, the petitioner wants to produce his evidence which is necessary for just and proper decision and since the petitioner is facing trial for offence under Section 306 Cr.P.C., therefore, he has a valuable right to call SI Nitin Dave as defence witness to justify his case.
In view of above, the impugned order dated 20.04.2019, passed by learned Additional Session Judge (Women Atrocities Cases) Jodhpur Metropolitan is hereby set aside.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge (Women Atrocities Cases) Jodhpur Metropolitan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The trial court is directed to call SI Nitin Dave for defence evidence immediately.
[2023:RJ-JD:25932] (3 of 3) [CRLMP-3244/2019] The misc. petition is allowed accordingly.
Stay application is also decided.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 534-MS/-
